segments.en: So the first thing you need to know about bowling is that you should never cross that line where the lane begins.
segments.zh: 所以你需要知道的关于保龄球的第一件事是，你永远不应该越过车道开始的那条线。

segments.en: Why not?
segments.zh: 为什么不呢？

segments.en: Because they polish and oil it to make the ball slide down.
segments.zh: 因为球道打过蜡、上过油，方便球沿着球道滚动。

segments.en: If you step there, you'll slip and fall.
segments.zh: 如果你走到那里，你会滑倒。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I got my bowling shoes, my ball, our names on the scorecard.
segments.zh: 所以我在记分卡上得到了我的保龄球鞋，我的球，我们的名字。

segments.en: So now how the heck do I play this?
segments.zh: 那么现在我该怎么玩这个呢？

segments.en: You throw the ball down the lane and try to knock down all the pins.
segments.zh: 把球沿球道投出去，尽量把所有球瓶都击倒。

segments.en: If you do, that is called a strike.
segments.zh: 一次全部击倒，就叫“全中”。

segments.en: If you don't knock them all down in the first try, then you get a chance to get the spare.
segments.zh: 如果你第一次没有把它们全部击倒，就有机会补中。

segments.en: After 10 frames, we add up the points and see who has the most.
segments.zh: 打完十帧后，我们把分数加起来，看谁分最高。

segments.en: 300 is a perfect score, but very hard to get.
segments.zh: 300是一个完美的分数，但很难得到。

segments.en: Got it.
segments.zh: 明白了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: I'm going to give it a go.
segments.zh: 我要试一试。

segments.en: Oh, no.
segments.zh: 哦，不。

segments.en: My ball went in the gutter.
segments.zh: 我的球掉进球沟了。

segments.en: I told you.
segments.zh: 我告诉过你。

segments.en: It's harder than you think.
segments.zh: 这比你想象的要难。

segments.en: Now let a pro show you how it's done.
segments.zh: 现在让专业人士向您展示它是如何完成的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We're back.
segments.zh: 我们回来了。

segments.en: So bowling is actually a very, kind of like a pastime in the United States.
segments.zh: 所以保龄球在美国其实是一种很常见的消遣活动。

segments.en: You get together with friends and you just go bowling.
segments.zh: 你和朋友聚在一起，你只是去打保龄球。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: I do believe it's also considered a sport.
segments.zh: 我相信它也被认为是一项运动。

segments.en: So many people play professionally or semi-professionally.
segments.zh: 很多人是职业或半职业地打保龄球。

segments.en: But for me, it's always been a very social game, something you do with a group of friends.
segments.zh: 但对我来说，这一直是一个非常社交的游戏，你和一群朋友一起做的事情。

segments.en: You go out.
segments.zh: 你出去。

segments.en: It's really fun.
segments.zh: 这真的很有趣。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And especially because when you go bowling, many people can play, right?
segments.zh: 尤其是因为当你去打保龄球时，很多人可以玩，对吧？

segments.en: Not obviously at the same time, but you take turns.
segments.zh: 显然不是同时，但你会轮流。

segments.en: And so while you're waiting, people are talking and eating.
segments.zh: 所以当你等待的时候，人们在说话和吃饭。

segments.en: So it is a very social activity.
segments.zh: 所以这是一项非常社交的活动。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So maybe a group of people will rent a lane.
segments.zh: 所以也许一群人会租一条车道。

segments.en: Remember, we were talking earlier about a lane being that one kind of strip of wood where you roll the ball.
segments.zh: 记住，我们前面说过，球道就是你滚球的那条木质长条。

segments.en: Well, a group of friends can rent a lane or two lanes and the four or the eight of you can play together, each person playing one frame at a time.
segments.zh: 好吧，一群朋友可以租一条车道或两条车道，而你们四人或八人可以一起玩，每个人一次玩一帧。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And now actually, the other thing about it is it's very funny to see people trying to bowl or maybe with the heavy ball or maybe they pass the line that we said they shouldn't pass and they slip and fall.
segments.zh: 还有一点也很有意思：看着别人打保龄球，也许拿个很重的球，或者越过了我们说不能越的那条线，然后滑倒。

segments.en: So I guess that's what also makes it a little bit fun to play.
segments.zh: 所以我想这也是让它有点有趣的原因。

segments.en: Yes, it can be a little bit embarrassing if you're not...
segments.zh: 是的，如果你打得不好，可能会有点尴尬……

segments.en: I'm not very good, so I'm a very embarrassing bowler.
segments.zh: 我打得不太好，所以我打保龄球时经常挺尴尬的。

segments.en: But it's also really fun because if you go and you just have a nice time, it's a very social game.
segments.zh: 但这也很有趣，因为如果你去了，你只是玩得开心，这是一个非常社交的游戏。

segments.en: Well, it is.
segments.zh: 嗯，是的。

segments.en: And actually, we are really curious to know if you've ever been bowling.
segments.zh: 实际上，我们真的很想知道您是否曾经打过保龄球。

segments.en: I know many people who've never been bowling and they find it very, very fun.
segments.zh: 我认识很多从未打过保龄球的人，他们觉得非常非常有趣。

segments.en: So why don't you come to our website EnglishPod.com and leave your questions and comments there as well.
segments.zh: 那么您为什么不来我们的网站 englishpod.com 并在那里留下您的问题和评论。

segments.en: Yeah, we hope to see you there.
segments.zh: 是的，我们希望在那里见到你。

segments.en: Until next time, guys.
segments.zh: 直到下一次，伙计们。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
